name: Curio Shop
desc1: This cramped, dimly-lit shop is cluttered with strange trinkets and
desc2: items of all description. A strange, sharp smell pervades the area,
desc3: probably from the mixture of incense burning in a pot near the back of
desc4: the room. A small, pretty Eastern woman stands behind a counter here,
desc5: and bows slightly as you enter. A bead curtain masks an exit to the
desc6: north, and you can leave to the south.
